capabilities: show a lock screen when the window loses focus
show a lock screen after a configurable inactivity delay on mobile
show the lock screen when the vault is opened
lock the vault from a command palette command
disambiguation: UI-only overlay; it provides no actual filesystem encryption.
extras: The README states the plugin is not under active development and invites forks; the mobile behavior is described as a workaround until the Obsidian API exposes app backgrounding events.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to obscure on-screen vault contents when leaving the device or window unattended.
summary: Lock screen overlay that hides the vault when the window loses focus, the app idles, at startup, or via a command.
